crossRefs.note: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.
the lord of that servant will come in a day when he doesn’t expect it, and in an hour when he doesn’t know it,
and will cut him in pieces, and appoint his portion with the hypocrites. That is where the weeping and grinding of…
He will say, ‘I tell you, I don’t know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.’
There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in God’s Kingdom…
he also will drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is prepared unmixed in the cup of his anger. He will be…
The smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever. They have no rest day and night, those who worship the beast and…
The fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was darkened. They gnawed their tongues…
and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores. They didn’t repent of their works.
